statement: For every linear3uniform hypergraph on99points with exactly231given triples and pointdegree7, its simple point graph is14regular and E_lambda=sum_(graph edges)(CN-1)^2 is zero if and only if its graph triangles are exactly those231given triples. If E_lambda is zero, then at every vertex the common-neighbor counts over its84nonneighbors have exact mean2. The mean conclusion does not require or imply that each individual nonadjacent pair has common-neighbor count2.
